note: Views Exposed Filters Summary provides a Views area handler (plugin id views_filters_summary, class ViewsFiltersSummary extends the core Result area, registered via hook_views_data). Added to a view display's header/footer/empty region, it prints a summary of the applied exposed filters using the content string tokens @total, @result_label, @exposed_filter_summary, with options show_labels, group_values, show_remove_link, show_reset_link, filters_reset_link_title, filters_summary_prefix, filters_summary_separator, filters_result_label, and a filters selection. There is NO config route and NO permissions; all state lives inside the view config entity under display_options.{header|footer|empty}.views_filters_summary (schema views.area.views_filters_summary). It exposes a family of alter hooks (hook_views_filters_summary_*) that its 11 submodules implement. Eval grounding: easy = code facts; medium = a planted view (vfs_known) whose summary-area options the agent reads back from live config; hard = building/altering the summary area on a real view (vfs_task / vfs_reset), verified against the live view config. No external service needed.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal views_filters_summary module, what kind of Views plugin does it provide, what is its plugin id, and where in a view do you place it to show a summary of the applied exposed filters?
evals.expected_output: It provides a Views AREA handler with plugin id views_filters_summary (class ViewsFiltersSummary, extending the core Result area). You add it to a view display's Header, Footer, or No-results (empty) area; there is no separate settings page.

evals.prompt: The views_filters_summary area has a 'content' text option. Which replacement tokens can I use in it to show the number of results, the result noun, and the list of active filters?
evals.expected_output: @total (total rows), @result_label (singular/plural result noun from filters_result_label), and @exposed_filter_summary (the rendered list of active exposed filters). The default content is 'Displaying @total @result_label @exposed_filter_summary'.

evals.prompt: How do I make the views_filters_summary show a remove link next to each active filter value and a single reset-all link? Name the handler options.
evals.expected_output: Enable show_remove_link for a per-value remove 'X' link (on by default) and show_reset_link for a reset-all link, with filters_reset_link_title setting its text. These are wired up client-side by the views_filters_summary/views_filters_summary JS library.

evals.prompt: This site has a view named 'vfs_known' that uses the views_filters_summary area. Inspect the live view configuration and report the exact 'Exposed Filters Summary Prefix' (filters_summary_prefix) that is configured on that summary area.
evals.expected_output: The prefix is 'VFS Known Prefix 7Q' — in the vfs_known view, display_options.footer.views_filters_summary.filters_summary_prefix.

evals.prompt: On this site, the view 'vfs_known' has a views_filters_summary area with a customized plural result label. Inspect the live view configuration and report the plural label (filters_result_label.plural) it uses.
evals.expected_output: The plural result label is 'vfsthings' — vfs_known view, display_options.footer.views_filters_summary.filters_result_label.plural.

evals.prompt: On this site there is a view with machine name 'vfs_task' that has an exposed Title filter but no filters summary. Using the views_filters_summary module, add its 'Views exposed filters summary' area handler to a display of that view (header, footer, or empty), and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add a handler with plugin_id 'views_filters_summary' under display_options.footer (or header/empty) of the vfs_task view and save it (e.g. via the Views UI 'Add' in Footer, or by editing the view config entity).

evals.prompt: My view 'vfs_reset' already shows a filters summary, but visitors can't clear all the filters at once. Turn on the reset-all link for that summary and save the change.
evals.expected_output: In the vfs_reset view, set the views_filters_summary area's show_reset_link option to TRUE (Views UI: tick 'Show reset filter link'; or set display_options.footer.views_filters_summary.show_reset_link = true and save).
